title: chevron expands venezuela position plans 7 billion investment 2026 09 02
text:
Sept 2 (Reuters) - Chevron (CVX.N)
, opens new tab
 said ‌on Wednesday it had agreed with Venezuela on updated ​terms for its joint ​ventures in the country ⁠and plans to invest ​more than $7 billion over ​the next five years, targeting production of about 600,000 bpd.
The expansion ​is the culmination ​of several months of negotiation conducted ‌separately ⁠from Washington's recent announcement of an unprecedented deal to take majority control of ​about 65 ​billion ⁠barrels of Venezuela's oil reserves.
The agreements ​provide enhanced fiscal, commercial ​and ⁠legal terms and include additional acreage in Venezuela's ⁠Orinoco ​Belt, the ​company said.
